name: ProgramBench
intro: ProgramBench评估智能体仅凭可执行程序与文档重建完整软件的能力。基准把200个开源程序转为离线黑盒任务，并以248,853个隐藏行为测试检验功能等价性。
org: Meta FAIR, Meta TBD, Stanford University, Harvard University
build_method: 智能体辅助的开源仓库转换、覆盖率驱动行为测试、弱断言过滤与源码剥离离线镜像
eval_feature: 无网络黑盒重建；禁止读取或反编译标准可执行文件；隐藏测试与作弊检测；每题最多1,000步和6小时
scale: 200个程序任务，248,853个测试函数，每题中位数770个测试
build_method_en: Agent-assisted open-source repository conversion, coverage-driven behavioral tests, weak-assertion filtering, and source-stripped offline images
eval_feature_en: Offline black-box reconstruction with no internet, executable reading, or decompilation; hidden tests and cheating detection; 1,000 steps and 6 hours per task
intro_en: ProgramBench evaluates whether agents can reconstruct complete software from only an executable and documentation. It converts 200 open-source programs into offline black-box tasks and checks behavioral equivalence with 248,853 hidden test functions.
scale_en: 200 program tasks, 248,853 test functions, median 770 tests per task
drawio_review_note: 2026-07-14：已纠正旧的Claude系统卡归属，按ProgramBench论文、官网与官方仓库核对仓库转换、行为测试、离线镜像、黑盒重建及三项指标，并完成中英文视觉与拓扑复核。
